pages.text: FROM: DOLORES$(br)TO: All Staff$(br)RE: Drying Out$(br2)Out of saline, a placed head loses 1 glass per 30 s; at 0 glass it is a real death. A full jar lasts 3 h 20 min, then 5 min of warnings.
pages.title: MEMO

pages.text: $(l)Not a death:$() losing the link, or your body dying (a corpse keeps your things).$(br2)$(l)Real death:$() your placed head breaking or drying while you walk, or dying as the jar. Modules drop; you respawn with a head.
